text:
maria: heads-up: p99 climbed sharply for us-west-serving around 1767512300, from ~0.28s to ~1.9s. Seeing spike across several routes.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: RTE-PERF-1767512345 severity=P1 tag=latency owners=eng-runtime
sam: joining. any quick dashboards or flamegraphs?
maria: perf link https://perf.redwood/trace/1767512345 id=pt_z9 - kvcache and kernel-selector panels attached
oliver: skimmed flameprof: kernel startup/setup overhead dominating; short sequences being sent to the large-kv kernel path. selector stats show sudden bump in high-mem kernel routing for seq_len<=32 (was near 5%, now ~78%).
ryan: digging tenant logs -> tenant-77 issued a spray of 4k-token jobs starting ~1767512260. kvcache eviction rate and miss-rate spiked at same time. noisy neighbor plausible.
tasha: symptoms: selector misroute + cache churn + small batch sizes = per-request overhead balloon. suggests immediate mitigation: 1) soft throttle tenant-77; 2) flip a route-level hint to prefer low-memory kernel for shortseq traffic; 3) temporarily raise kvcache reserve for us-west-serving; 4) prevent adaptive_batch shrink until cache recovers.
sam: agree. who can apply the changes quickly? want minimal global blast radius.
oliver: I can push a short TTL selector hint and a feature flag for route-level fallback. Also can run a prefix replay to warm hot prefixes. Commands below.
oliver: selector hint (15m TTL):
```
redwoodctl kernel-selector apply --route us-west-serving --set prefer_lowmem_shortseq=true --ttl 900
```
oliver: feature flag route toggle:
```
redwoodctl featureflags set --route us-west-serving --flag shortseq_fallback=true
```
ryan: throttle tenant-77:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane.internal/tenants/tenant-77/throttle -d '{"qps":8}'
```
tasha: bump kvcache reserve (ops only):
```
redwoodctl pool update us-west-serving --kvcache-reserve=0.2
```
ops-bot: executing changes: applying selector hint, setting featureflag, queueing tenant throttle, bumping cache reserve, pausing adaptive_batch_shrink. Actions will be logged.
maria: initiating throttle now
maria: throttle API -> 200 OK (applied)
incident-bot: action logged: tenant throttle applied by maria
oliver: kicked off prefix-replay job for top-2k prefixes to speed warmup
sam: monitoring: p95 flat, p99 trending down from 1.9s -> 0.7s over last 90s. KV hit rate up from 20% -> 65%.
ryan: started short continuous sampling of flamegraphs for shortseq requests vs longseq to confirm kernel overhead reduced (trace id pt_z9-sample-1).
tasha: applying alert fatigue override for this window to avoid pager spam; keep page if p99>1.5s for >5m.
maria: putting a customer note in #incidents and opening the bridge. will update if we change TTLs.
ops-bot: all temporary mitigations applied. selector hint ttl=900s, featureflag=enabled, throttle tenant-77=8qps, kvcache-reserve=0.2, adaptive_batch_shrink=paused
sam: next steps / follow-up: 1) if stable for 30m, roll back selector hint & featureflag; 2) investigate selector regression and add hysteresis to prevent flip on transient eviction; 3) consider per-tenant eviction protection to avoid eviction storms; 4) add synthetic warmup when cache-reserve dips. assign oliver & ryan for traces.
oliver: filing PERF-5901 with flamegraphs, kvcache traces, prefix-replay logs, and selector snapshots. assigning to eng-runtime.
maria: p99 now ~0.33s, holding. will monitor for full TTL and then revert if steady.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations applied and monitored. Incident RTE-PERF-1767512345 marked RESOLVED by maria at 1767512680
